benefits.title: 关键词与语义兼得
benefits.body: 内置 BM25 全文检索，与稠密向量在一次混合检索里融合，精确 ID 和换了说法的问题都能命中对的 chunk。

benefits.title: 按租户检索
benefits.body: 过滤表达式在向量检索内部执行。partition key 让多个租户共享一个 collection，官方文档给的规模是百万级租户。

benefits.title: 答案不过期
benefits.body: upsert 按主键替换 chunk，delete 直接移除，每个请求可指定一致性级别，决定读到的数据多新。

benefits.title: 知识库大，账单小
benefits.body: 磁盘索引、mmap 和分层存储让大部分知识库数据放在 SSD 或对象存储，而不是全压在内存。

feature_blocks.title: 混合检索 + grep
feature_blocks.body: RAG 的问题常常一半是语义、一半是精确字符串：错误码、SKU、条款编号。一次 hybrid_search 完成稠密和 BM25 的多路召回，再用模式过滤收窄。
bullets: 稠密与 BM25 结果用 RRF 或加权 ranker 融合
正则过滤（=~、!~，RE2 语法）支持 VARCHAR、JSON 字符串和数组；LIKE 可用 NGRAM 索引加速
TEXT_MATCH、PHRASE_MATCH、TEXT_MATCH_FUZZY 覆盖词项、短语和容错匹配

feature_blocks.title: Function Chain 做 RAG 重排序
feature_blocks.body: Milvus 3.0 起，Function Chain 在一次检索请求里跑有序重排流水线：segment 级、QueryNode 级、全局归并后各一层，无需客户端回查再重排。
bullets: 把向量分数和时效（decay）、热度（加权组合）揉成一个分数
调用 Cohere、Voyage AI、vLLM、TEI 等重排模型
排序、截断候选；search 和 hybrid search 都能用

feature_blocks.title: Learning to rerank
feature_blocks.body: 用相关性标注或点击数据离线训练 XGBoost 排序模型，注册到 Milvus，Function Chain 直接给召回的 chunk 打分。
bullets: 特征取自标量字段：时效、来源权威度、使用次数
XGBoost 原生打分在 QueryNode 上执行，紧挨着数据
也有规则型方案：boost ranker 与 decay ranker

feature_blocks.title: 磁盘索引降成本
feature_blocks.body: 不是每个 chunk 都得常驻内存，按延迟预算选内存占用。
bullets: DiskANN 把图和原始向量放 SSD；AISAQ 几乎全部放 SSD
mmap 与分层存储按需从磁盘或对象存储加载
量化索引：IVF_RABITQ（最高 1:32 压缩）、IVF_SQ8、IVF_PQ

code.h2: RAG 向量数据库示例：按租户检索
code.intro: 存入带 tenant 字段的 chunk，检索某个客户的 top 匹配，再拼进 LLM 的 prompt。
code.code:
# pip install -U "pymilvus[milvus-lite]"
from pymilvus import MilvusClient

client = MilvusClient("rag_demo.db")  # same code against http://localhost:19530 or Zilliz Cloud
client.create_collection(collection_name="chunks", dimension=768)

# embed() is your embedding model (768 dimensions here)
client.insert(collection_name="chunks", data=[
    {"id": 1, "vector": embed("Rotate API keys under Settings > Security."), "tenant": "acme",
     "text": "Rotate API keys under Settings > Security."},
])

hits = client.search(
    collection_name="chunks",
    data=[embed("How do I rotate API keys?")],
    filter='tenant == "acme"',          # retrieve only this customer's documents
    limit=5,
    output_fields=["text"],
)
context = "\n\n".join(h["entity"]["text"] for h in hits[0])  # put into your LLM prompt
code.note: embed() 换成你的 embedding 模型。BM25 + 稠密混合检索和正则过滤见混合检索与模式匹配文档。

faqs: RAG 知识库用什么向量数据库？
选能把检索全包的：关键词加语义检索、租户过滤、重排、匹配语料规模的存储层。Milvus 开源版四样都有，Lite 到 Distributed 一套 API。
RAG 就是向量数据库吗？向量数据库和知识库的区别在哪？
不是。知识库是文档和 chunk，向量数据库存向量并检索出相关 chunk，RAG 是“检索 + 大模型生成”整条链路，Milvus 管检索这一半。
RAG 混合检索还需要 Elasticsearch 吗？
不需要。Milvus 原生支持 BM25，还有正则、LIKE、TEXT_MATCH 过滤，hybrid_search 一次请求就把关键词和稠密结果融合。
RAG 重排序能用自己的模型吗？
可以。Milvus 3.0+ 的 Function Chain 能在检索请求内用你的 XGBoost 模型基于标量特征打分，也能调用托管重排模型。
大模型知识库搭建怎么起步？
pip 装 Milvus Lite 先做本地知识库，向量数据库 API 与集群一致；接 LangChain 或 Dify，数据量大了换 Distributed 或 Zilliz Cloud，代码不改。

final.h2: 给大模型知识库配一个生产级的向量检索器
final.body: 先在 notebook 里用 Milvus Lite，接入 LangChain、LlamaIndex 或 Dify，向量数据库这层不用换；再随语料增长加上混合检索、grep 过滤、重排链和磁盘索引。

notes: Meituan (10B+ vectors, 100+ use cases, 2B+ single collection, self-run open-source Milvus, quote 'from RAG to agent memory') and Read AI (sub 20-50 ms, millions of monthly users) re-checked on zilliz.com customer pages 2026-10-21. Read AI page does not say RAG explicitly; copy says 'retrieval'.
Snippet is quick-setup MilvusClient on Milvus Lite with a dynamic 'tenant' field filter; partition key is described in copy, not shown, to keep the snippet short. Not executed end to end.
Model ranker provider list trimmed to four of the providers named in model-ranker-overview.
Partition key 'millions of tenants' is the docs' wording; partition-key isolation is HNSW-only per use-partition-key docs.
Read AI story names other vector databases as rejected alternatives; omitted on purpose.

Function Chain: released in Milvus 3.0.0 (release notes 'Function Chain reranking'; PRs #47919, #50786), L1 stage in 3.0.1 (#52745), Hybrid Search support in 3.0.3 (#53541), dynamic fields in 3.0.3 (#54011). PyMilvus API FunctionChain / FunctionChainStage / function_chain.fn (decay, num_combine, round_decimal, rerank_model, xgboost) ships in pymilvus 3.0.1+. It is a rerank/scoring pipeline, NOT an embedding pipeline. DOCS MISSING: milvus-docs v3.0.x has no user guide page for Function Chain (only release notes + roadmap) - confirm a doc page exists before launch, or link release notes.

Learning to rank: released as the native `xgboost` Function Chain expression (milvus #51317 in v3.0.0; design doc 20260708-xgboost-function-chain.md; issue #51192). Scope: L0 rerank only (per segment on QueryNode), UBJ-format XGBoost models registered as a FileResource, features = scalar columns in argument order, output raw|default. No training inside Milvus; no L2 support yet. Not documented on milvus.io (docs missing - confirm before launch). Copy says 'learning-to-rank' because the design doc frames it that way; we do not claim a generic LTR framework.

Grep: regex =~ / !~ (RE2) is labelled 'Milvus 3.0.x' in pattern-matching docs, targets VARCHAR, JSON string paths and ARRAY elements; NGRAM accelerates LIKE and eligible regex filters; TEXT_MATCH_FUZZY is 'Milvus 3.0.0+' in keyword-match docs. FMINDEX intentionally not mentioned.
Weighted RRF (per-request weights) shipped in 3.0.1 (#52926); copy just says RRF / weighted.

Docs label AISAQ (Milvus 2.6.4+), Tiered Storage (2.6.4+) and Boost Ranker (2.6.2+) as beta. Copy does not say beta; decide before launch. Memory facts used only as documented: DiskANN keeps PQ codes in RAM and raw vectors + graph on SSD; AISAQ keeps all index data on SSD; IVF_RABITQ docs state a 1-to-32 compression ratio; SQ8 = 8-bit ints instead of 32-bit floats.
Code snippet kept (approved tenant-scoped MilvusClient example); hybrid_search + regex example not added because a runnable BM25 schema makes it ~30 lines.
